reviewScope: All 338 JPEGs inventoried with full-decode attempts and chronological review in 5 contact sheets; 337 decoded successfully. Shortlisted candidates reviewed again at up to 492 pixels, with the cover at 1600 pixels. Corrupt images are explicitly excluded.
dateSource: Nikon DateTimeOriginal was recorded in India time, explicitly confirmed by the owner. Convert Asia/Kolkata (+05:30) to America/Vancouver (−08:00 in February 2024), subtracting 13 hours 30 minutes. Camera timestamps remain recorded separately; corrected Vancouver dates are 21–26 February 2024.
locationNotes: Visible landmarks, readable signs and capture order establish places; Dubai GPS supports its neighbourhoods. Exact original GPS is not copied into the manifest or published derivatives.
Vancouver originals lack usable GPS. Unidentified forest trails, lake and inlet use broader Vancouver-area labels; the signed Whistler mountain scenes are labelled Whistler Blackcomb.

Nikon DateTimeOriginal was recorded in India time, explicitly confirmed by the owner. Convert Asia/Kolkata (+05:30) to America/Vancouver (−08:00 in February 2024), subtracting 13 hours 30 minutes. Camera timestamps remain recorded separately; corrected Vancouver dates are 21–26 February 2024.
No itinerary or completed source archive for this collection was present. Existing extracted originals were reviewed without extraction or renaming.
Originals, videos, private travel records and review sheets remain outside the website and R2. Only selected metadata-free WebP derivatives are exported.
criteria: Choose distinct clear landscapes, architecture, interiors, wildlife, market details and candid daily life; compare bursts and avoid padding limited locations.
Group chronologically by actual local capture date and supported location; use broader labels where the exact site is uncertain.
Keep each cover once in its album and daily count, without repeating it in the gallery.
Preserve original framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation, omit EXIF/XMP, and export quality-84 WebP at 2000 pixels or 2400 for the cover.
Local people, crowds and some personal photographs are allowed. peoplePhotoSources is a conservative list for later review without identifying or matching faces.

chapterCounts.location: Lake and forest trails, Vancouver area

omissionReasons: Repeated scenes and near-identical bursts, weaker framing, blurred or badly exposed frames, and most posed portraits.
Routine transport logistics, long flight sequences and private travel documents.
Videos are outside the selected still-photo essay. Corrupt JPEGs are preserved but never exported.
